portraits.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: supplied real editor portrait. Create a very gentle artistic editorial portrait for the Kabita Live literary journal. Pradeep Biswal. Preserve his front-facing pose, soft moustache, natural facial asymmetry, dark side-parted hair, navy waistcoat and turquoise checked shirt. Preserve the EXACT recognisable facial geometry, proportions, expression, eyes, nose, lips, complexion and age of the original person. Keep face photographic and faithful; no beautification, rejuvenation, skin lightening, facial reconstruction or invented facial details. Artistic treatment belongs primarily in the backdrop and outer garment edges: replace busy/plain photographic background with warm ivory handmade paper (#F5EFDF), extremely soft muted sea-blue (#125465) and hearth-ochre (#78643A) watercolor washes behind shoulders, delicate dry-brush fading at lower outer garment edges into paper. Very restrained warm laterite (#963F28) traces at periphery only. Keep the head, hair, ears and central upper body crisp and unchanged in form. No decorative objects, text, border, signature or symbols. Square composition matching original framing, quiet poetic literary magazine portrait, subtle realistic watercolor mixed-media touch.
